title: docs/tests: the disabled-package search rule is missing from the searchAll contract docblock and the handbook, and has no real-registry pin
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbP6iSEGkWb5fn8yqd

Filing gate ①: the three nits (N1–N3) of contract review 7003145171 on PR #35367 (card #35195, merged `ee40658d0d`), collected into one follow-up as the review allowed.

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；文档补上“停用的模块不出现在全局搜索里”，再加一条用真实环境验证的测试。
- 为什么做：全局搜索的停用规则已经上线，但说明文字和测试只覆盖了一半。
- 出错会怎样：只是文档和测试，行为不变，撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Items
- N1: `searchAll`'s contract docblock in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` lists each skip (exposure, read admission) but not the disabled-package one; the reason sits only at the guard in `protocol-record-reads.ts`.
- N2: `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` "Data plane" bullet names the data routes and by-name metadata reads but not global search ("global search leaves the module's records out"). Docs-only.
- N3: no pin drives the search door over the real `SchemaRegistry` with a really disabled package (disable, then `GET /api/v1/search`); the unit pin uses a registry double. A runtime-level case covers the wiring.
Also (os-dev note on #35195): `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` cites `protocol.package-disable-enforcement.test.ts`, which does not exist in `packages/metadata-protocol/src`.

Suggested-grade: p3 · domain:server · area:package (rides a same-file p2 PR, e.g. #35427's).
